nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What practical recommendations does the study provide?
nodes.answer: The study provides practical recommendations for improving MPA management and mitigating NIS risks.
nodes.paragraph: This study pro- vides practical recommendations for improving MPA management and mitigating NIS risks, contributing to regional conservation efforts. Additionally, it estab- lishes a baseline risk assessment approach that can be customised and expanded to guide NIS management and biodiversity conservation in other regions, par - ticularly those with similar challenges. Nuno Castro and Jo o Gama Monteiro contributed equally to this study.
